label: MGS-1

material.role: InSight sandy-layer initial DP trial with MGS-1 shear parameters
assumptions: InSight target density and predicted 1 m wave speeds determine common initial elastic moduli
Apparent cohesion and peak friction digitized approximately from MGS-1 at about 1320 kg/m3
Transfer to 1300 kg/m3 assumes the nearby measured coefficients; zero dilation and hardening are initial assumptions
Direct-shear normal stress 0.097–0.68 kPa; no site-specific strength or foundation-pressure validation

loading: Constant lateral confinement, then displacement-controlled axial compression without selfweight
scope: Numerical specimen using transferred initial parameters
